$comment: Generated by tools/catalogue.py. Do not edit by hand, and do not restate any of it elsewhere -- read it.

steps: Download the .zip - do not unzip it.
In Claude, open Settings, then Customize, then Skills.
Start a new conversation and describe your problem. Claude picks the skill up on its own.
install.note: An installed skill never updates itself. Re-upload the zip to move to a newer version.

skills.title: Funnel Drop-off Analyst
skills.description: Finds where candidates leave your hiring funnel, separates correlation from cause, and ranks the fixes by how many hires they would recover.

skills.title: Job Ad Writer
skills.description: Writes high-volume hourly job ads that work on a phone, with a variant for each channel you post to.

coming_soon.title: No-Show Pattern Finder
coming_soon.description: Finds out why hires don't turn up for their first shift, and which single change would recover the most starts.

coming_soon.title: Source ROI Analyst
coming_soon.description: Joins channel spend to hiring outcomes to produce cost per start and cost per retained hire, rather than cost per application.

coming_soon.title: Time-to-Hire Analyst
coming_soon.description: Breaks hiring cycle time down stage by stage and names the one stage actually holding the queue, rather than the one that looks slowest.

coming_soon.title: Turnover Analyst
coming_soon.description: Breaks down 30, 60 and 90-day attrition by location, manager, source and role, and separates which of them is actually driving it.

coming_soon.title: AI Hiring Law Briefer
coming_soon.description: Explains the categories of obligation that regulation of automated hiring tools imposes, and helps you work out which of your own tools it applies to.

coming_soon.title: Audit Prep Pack
coming_soon.description: Assembles the document and process inventory an I-9 or wage-hour audit will ask for, and separates record problems from process problems.

coming_soon.title: E-Verify Process Mapper
coming_soon.description: Maps your E-Verify workflow against its timing rules and the tentative non-confirmation path, and finds where a multi-site process quietly breaks.

coming_soon.title: I-9 Readiness Checker
coming_soon.description: Walks the US Form I-9 process, flags the errors that show up most in audits, and builds a completion checklist for high-volume hiring.

coming_soon.title: Multi-State Rule Comparer
coming_soon.description: Builds a side-by-side comparison structure and research checklist for hiring and onboarding requirements across the states you operate in.

coming_soon.title: Interview No-Show Playbook
coming_soon.description: Diagnoses why booked interviews get missed from your funnel data, then writes the confirm, remind and reschedule sequence and the slot rules that fix it.

coming_soon.title: Interview Panel Calibrator
coming_soon.description: Gets multiple interviewers onto the same bar and proves it with a calibration exercise, then reads the disagreement to find what actually needs fixing.

coming_soon.title: Interview Question Bank
coming_soon.description: Builds a role-family question bank with follow-up probes, scoring notes and safe alternatives to the questions managers should not ask.

coming_soon.title: Phone Screen Script
coming_soon.description: Writes a five-minute phone screen that leads with availability, decides on the call, and ends with a booked next step.

coming_soon.title: Structured Interview Guide
coming_soon.description: Builds a fifteen-minute frontline interview guide a store or site manager can run consistently, without training.

coming_soon.title: Day-One Readiness Checklist
coming_soon.description: Builds the checklist of everything that must be true before a new hire's first shift, by role and location, with an owner and a deadline on every line.

coming_soon.title: Manager Ramp Plan
coming_soon.description: Builds a first-30-days ramp plan for an hourly role that a shift manager can run in about twelve minutes a week, and hand to a shift lead.

coming_soon.title: New-Hire Pack Drafter
coming_soon.description: Writes the welcome pack, first-week schedule and practical day-one instructions an hourly new hire will actually read on a phone before their first shift.

coming_soon.title: Onboarding Drop-off Diagnostic
coming_soon.description: Finds where accepted offers die before the first shift, and separates the delays you created from the candidates who were never going to start.

coming_soon.title: Onboarding Workflow Designer
coming_soon.description: Designs the offer-to-first-shift workflow for hourly roles, with a named owner, a deadline and a fallback on every step that can stall.

coming_soon.title: Headcount Forecaster
coming_soon.description: Derives how many applications you need next quarter from demand, seasonality and expected attrition, and names the assumption most likely to be wrong.

coming_soon.title: Hiring Ops SOP Builder
coming_soon.description: Turns how-we-do-it-here into a written procedure another person can run, documenting the real process rather than the ideal one.

coming_soon.title: Recruiter Capacity Planner
coming_soon.description: Measures real recruiter load rather than req count, finds the load level where your process starts to slow down, and ranks automation by hours returned.

coming_soon.title: Stalled Applicant Triage
coming_soon.description: Decides what to do with every applicant stuck in your pipeline — chase, re-route or close — using your own median time-in-stage to define stalled, and records a reason on every close.

coming_soon.title: Weekly Hiring Review Pack
coming_soon.description: Builds a weekly hiring pack of four or five leading indicators with exception reporting, plus the meeting agenda that turns it into decisions.

coming_soon.title: Check-In Designer
coming_soon.description: Writes day 1, day 7 and day 30 check-in scripts for new hourly hires, with escalation rules for whatever comes back.

coming_soon.title: Coverage Risk Scorer
coming_soon.description: Scores which locations are likely to be short-staffed next week from an attendance and headcount export, and says whether each one is a hiring or a reliability problem.

coming_soon.title: Early Attrition Diagnostic
coming_soon.description: Diagnoses the mechanism behind 30-day quits and traces each one back to the hiring decision that caused it.

coming_soon.title: Exit Reason Analyst
coming_soon.description: Clusters free-text exit responses into a stable set of causes you can act on, weighted by how many people they actually affect.

coming_soon.title: Stay Interview Kit
coming_soon.description: Builds the stay-interview questions, cadence and follow-up rules for hourly workers, timed to the points where they actually leave.

coming_soon.title: Bias Language Checker
coming_soon.description: Reviews job ads and screening questions for exclusionary wording and adverse-impact risk, and rewrites the lines that carry it.

coming_soon.title: Knockout Logic Auditor
coming_soon.description: Reviews your existing screening rules against funnel data and finds the questions quietly killing your applicant flow.

coming_soon.title: Resume-Free Triage Rubric
coming_soon.description: Builds a triage rubric for hourly roles where most applicants have no resume, scoring availability, reliability signals, travel and certifications instead of work history.

coming_soon.title: Scorecard Designer
coming_soon.description: Builds a role scorecard with behavioural anchors that a site manager who has never interviewed can score during the conversation.

coming_soon.title: Rehire Campaign Planner
coming_soon.description: Plans a re-engagement campaign against your own past applicants and former workers, covering who you may contact, how to segment them, the messages, and what to do with the replies.

coming_soon.title: Attendance Policy Writer
coming_soon.description: Writes no-call/no-show, lateness and break policies in language hourly teams and site managers actually follow, structured so the same event produces the same outcome at every site.

coming_soon.title: Candidate Message Sequencer
coming_soon.description: Builds short SMS, WhatsApp and email nudge sequences for applicants who stall between applying and their first shift, timed to the stage they stalled at.

coming_soon.title: Manager Comms Writer
coming_soon.description: Writes the daily messages a district or store manager sends — shift coverage asks, interview reminders, day-one instructions, schedule changes — in the voice of someone the reader sees every day.

coming_soon.title: Offer Letter Drafter
coming_soon.description: Drafts conditional offers, start-date confirmations and contingency wording for hourly roles, with the shift pattern and first-shift logistics in the same message.
